description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a symbolic sequence containing operators, brackets, and mixed‑format tokens exactly as provided, without reinterpretation or normalisation.

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output both lines exactly as provided, preserving brackets, operators, symbols, spacing, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire symbolic block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
